hints: Identify the four boundaries of the shaded region: arc $CD$, radial segment $CA$, radial segment $BD$, and straight chord $AB$.
Calculate radial straight lengths $CA = BD = 10 - 6 = 4\text{ cm}$ and circular arc length $\text{arc } CD = r\theta = 6(0.8) = 4.8\text{ cm}$.
Calculate chord length $AB$ using trigonometry ($AB = 2 \times 10\sin(0.4)$) or the cosine rule on $\triangle OAB$.
walkthrough:
Calculate the lengths of the straight radial segments $CA$ and $BD$:
$$CA = OA - OC = 10 - 6 = 4\text{ cm}, \quad BD = OB - OD = 10 - 6 = 4\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the arc length of arc $CD$ with radius $r = 6\text{ cm}$ and $\theta = 0.8\text{ rad}$:
$$\text{Arc } CD = r\theta = 6 \times 0.8 = 4.8\text{ cm}$$

Find the straight chord length $AB$ using trigonometry on isosceles $\triangle OAB$:
$$AB = 2 \times 10\sin(0.4) = 20\sin(0.4) \approx 20 \times 0.38942 = 7.7884\text{ cm}$$

Sum all four boundary pieces to find the total perimeter:
$$\text{Perimeter} = \text{Arc } CD + CA + AB + BD = 4.8 + 4 + 7.7884 + 4 = 20.5884 \approx 20.6\text{ cm (to 3 s.f.)}$$

hints: Notice that the shaded area equals the area of $\triangle OAB$ minus the area of circular sector $OCD$.
Use the triangle area formula $\text{Area}(\triangle OAB) = \frac{1}{2}ab\sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}(10)(10)\sin(0.8)$.
Use the sector area formula $\text{Area}(\text{Sector } OCD) = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}(6^2)(0.8)$.
walkthrough:
The shaded area is the area of triangle $OAB$ minus the area of circular sector $OCD$:
$$\text{Shaded Area} = \text{Area}(\triangle OAB) - \text{Area}(\text{Sector } OCD)$$

Calculate the area of triangle $OAB$ with $OA = OB = 10\text{ cm}$ and $\angle AOB = 0.8\text{ rad}$:
$$\text{Area}(\triangle OAB) = \frac{1}{2}(10)(10)\sin(0.8) = 50\sin(0.8) \approx 50 \times 0.71736 = 35.8678\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of sector $OCD$ with $r = 6\text{ cm}$ and $\theta = 0.8\text{ rad}$:
$$\text{Area}(\text{Sector } OCD) = \frac{1}{2}(6^2)(0.8) = \frac{1}{2}(36)(0.8) = 14.4\text{ cm}^2$$

Subtract the sector area from the triangle area:
$$\text{Shaded Area} = 35.8678 - 14.4 = 21.4678 \approx 21.5\text{ cm}^2 \text{ (to 3 s.f.)}$$
